## :star: New Features

- `FluencyLogbackAppender` can send the SLF4J message template (`"User {} logged in"`) in its own field next to the formatted message, so log backends can group and count by template. The field is only added when the template differs from the message. Turn it on with `<captureMessageTemplate>true</captureMessageTemplate>`; the field name defaults to `message_template` and is set with `<messageTemplateFieldName>`. Off by default [#23](https://github.com/montss/logback-more-appenders/pull/23)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Document the message template option in the README and the Fluentd sample config, and turn it on in the Spring Boot 2.7 and 3.x examples

## :hammer: Dependency Upgrades

- Upgrade fluency from 2.6.5 to 2.7.3. It runs on Spring Boot 2.7, 3.0 and 3.1, checked in CI with each version's own Jackson. fluency 2.7.4 is not used yet: it needs Jackson 2.18 and Spring Boot 3.4 or later [#22](https://github.com/montss/logback-more-appenders/pull/22)
- Upgrade Jackson from 2.10.5 to 2.15.2, the version fluency 2.7.3 is built against [#22](https://github.com/montss/logback-more-appenders/pull/22)
